name: Titanium.Calendar.RecurrenceRule
summary: An object that is used to describe the recurrence pattern for a recurring event.
description:
On Android there is no option to have multiple recurrence rules set for the same event.
Android always uses only the first element in the array passed to [recurrenceRules](api:Titanium.Calendar.Event#recurrenceRules).

In case of having [daysOfTheWeek](api:Titanium.Calendar.RecurrenceRule#daysOfTheWeek) and [daysOfTheMonth](api:Titanium.Calendar.RecurrenceRule#daysOfTheWeek)
for an event with a recurrence rule of type [RECURRENCEFREQUENCY_MONTHLY](api:Titanium.Calendar#RECURRENCEFREQUENCY_MONTHLY) only
[daysOfTheWeek] will be used.

properties.name: calendarID
properties.summary: Identifier for the recurrence rule's calendar.

properties.name: daysOfTheMonth
properties.summary:
The days of the month that the event occurs, as an array of number objects.
Values can be from 1 to 31 and from -1 to -31. This parameter is only valid for
recurrence rules of type
[RECURRENCEFREQUENCY_MONTHLY](api:Titanium.Calendar#RECURRENCEFREQUENCY_MONTHLY).

properties.name: daysOfTheWeek
properties.summary: The days of the week that the event occurs, as an array of objects `daysOfWeek` and `Week`.
properties.description:
On Android daysOfTheWeek is not valid for recurrence rules of type
[RECURRENCEFREQUENCY_YEARLY](api:Titanium.Calendar#RECURRENCEFREQUENCY_YEARLY).

properties.name: daysOfWeek
properties.summary: The day of the week. Values are from 1 to 7, with Sunday being 1.

properties.name: week
properties.summary:
The week number of the day of the week.
Values range from -53 to 53. A negative value indicates a value from the end of
the range. 0 indicates the week number is irrelevant.

properties.name: daysOfTheYear
properties.summary:
The days of the year that the event occurs, as an array of number objects.
Values can be from 1 to 366 and from -1 to -366. This parameter is only valid for
recurrence rules of type [RECURRENCEFREQUENCY_YEARLY](api:Titanium.Calendar#RECURRENCEFREQUENCY_YEARLY).

properties.name: end
properties.description:
The recurrence end can be specified by a date (date-based) or by a maximum count
of occurrences (count-based). An event which is set to never end **should not**
have its `recurrenceEnd set. Either `endDate` or `occurrenceCount` property will be
present.

properties.name: endDate
properties.summary: End date of the recurrence end, or undefined if the recurrence end is count-based.

properties.name: occurrenceCount
properties.summary: Occurrence count of the recurrence end, or 0 if the recurrence end is date-based.

properties.name: interval
properties.summary:
The interval between instances of this recurrence. For example, a weekly
recurrence rule with an interval of 2 occurs every other week. Must be greater than 0.

properties.name: monthsOfTheYear
properties.summary:
The months of the year that the event occurs, as an array of Number objects.
Values can be from 1 to 12. This parameter is only valid for recurrence rules of
type [RECURRENCEFREQUENCY_YEARLY](api:Titanium.Calendar#RECURRENCEFREQUENCY_YEARLY).

properties.name: setPositions
properties.summary:
An array of ordinal numbers that filters which recurrences to include in the
recurrence rule's frequency. For example, a yearly recurrence rule that has a
[daysOfTheWeek](api:Titanium.Calendar.RecurrenceRule#daysOfTheWeek) value that specifies
Monday through Friday, and a `setPositions` array containing 2 and -1, occurs only
on the second weekday and last weekday of every year.

properties.name: weeksOfTheYear
properties.summary:
The weeks of the year that the event occurs, as an array of number objects.
Values can be from 1 to 53 and from -1 to -53. This parameter is only valid for
recurrence rules of type [RECURRENCEFREQUENCY_YEARLY](api:Titanium.Calendar#RECURRENCEFREQUENCY_YEARLY).
